title: Offer response
description: What GET /offers/{offer_id} returns (docs/spec-v1.md, section 7.1). A resolver may add members. A wallet verifies the offer itself and checks that its ID is the one requested; nothing else in this response is signed.

encoded_offer.description: The offer as one lowercase Bech32m string. Spec 5.

disabled.description: Reference resolver: true once the offer is revoked or switched off.

valid.description: Reference resolver: whether the stored offer passes verification under the rules this resolver runs.
